rows.grounds: first member of a numerical compound specifying the quantity eighty-four
locative plural expressing the large numerical scale
compound denoting womb-devices as the locus of suffering
describes beings subjected to affliction within those loci

items.question: Within how many womb-mechanisms are beings subjected to torment?
premises: The quantity specified is eighty-four thousand.
Beings within these loci are tormented.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment across eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is not explicitly stated in this verse and is inferred from context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
